general_information.Description: Learn how to keep your audience engaged by focusing on the content and delivery of public address in this course. It is the responsibility of the tourism-related lecturer to provide each student with a variety of themes and requirements for their presentations. Most importantly, the training will help students gain the confidence and skills necessary to deal with a wide range of circumstances and customer files in the tourism sector (narrative about scenic spots, presentation of highlights of local culture, introduction and typical tourist attractions of the country, .. are topics that should be covered in the course)
general_information.StudentTasks: - Students must attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination. - Student is responsible to do all exercises, assignments and labs given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time - Use laptop in class only for learning purpose - Promptly access to the FU CMS at http://flm.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information

description: Learn how to keep your audience engaged by focusing on the content and delivery of public address in this course. It is the responsibility of the tourism-related lecturer to provide each student with a variety of themes and requirements for their presentations. Most importantly, the training will help students gain the confidence and skills necessary to deal with a wide range of circumstances and customer files in the tourism sector (narrative about scenic spots, presentation of highlights of local culture, introduction and typical tourist attractions of the country, .. are topics that should be covered in the course)

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Understand the fundamentals of writing and outline a presentation related to tourism topics
Master the tactics required to prepare for a speech and speak in public.
Develop and present logical arguments to persuade the audience.
Build and present logical arguments to convince the audience, helping them better understand the cultural values of tourist destinations
During keynotes, present a professionally to inspire travelers
Apply the theory to your own speech in the most sensible and appealing way possible.
Understand the requirements and show self-confidence, control face, emotions and attitude while presenting to tourists

assessments.Question Type: A brief overview of no more than two pages that summarizes the main points of your speech.
assessments.Grading Guide: Each person creates an outline for his or her presentation based on the topic chosen by the lecturer. Before presenting the topic to the class, individual outlines must be submitted.

assessments.Question Type: To complete the, all students must give an oral presentation in front of the class. The course lecturers are required to record the full student presentation for the best assessment and to compare the results with following speeches.
assessments.Grading Guide: The final speech will be roughly 10 minutes long and can be delivered by individuals. Participants will be required to present about a topic / tourist destination / news event / etc (as assigned by the lecturer in charge of the subject), and the speech must include the following elements: - Informative - Inspiring listeners - Persuading the audience

assessments.Question Type: To complete the, all students must give an oral presentation in front of the class. The course lecturers are required to record the full student presentation for the best assessment and to compare the results with following speeches.
assessments.Grading Guide: in class, by instructor. An informative speech is five minutes long and is intended to enlighten rather than persuade. The lecturer in charge of the course provides the topic.

assessments.Question Type: Each student shoud make at least 1 individual presentation/ case analysis during the course in front of the class
assessments.Grading Guide: Participation grade will be given based on students' preparation, and quantity as well as quality of participation in classroom; quality of participation is demonstrated through asking relevant questions, making statements that add to and facilitate class discussion, and builds upon others’ comments. Class preparation and pre-reading before lecture will be assessed upon individuals' understanding and ability to answer questions in the class. Individuals will be called up randomly to be assessed.

assessments.Question Type: To complete the, all students must give an oral presentation in front of the class. The course lecturers are required to record the full student presentation for the best assessment and to compare the results with following speeches.
assessments.Grading Guide: in class, by instructor. A persuasive speech is a 6-8 minute speech designed to change the audience's behavior or beliefs about a specific topic. Please note that this is not a political forum and highly controversial topics are not suitable for this venue. Since the time frame for this presentation has a two-minute period, you should stay within that period. The topic will be chosen by student

assessments.Note: The exam questions must be updated or different at least 70% to the previous ones.
